title: Pregnant Blend 2-Mix Duo #15 (세로 띠 3구역·매끈 / 가로 띠 3구역·매끈)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side, each an extraordinarily large pregnant woman, far beyond any real person.

#1: Thai, in her mid 50s, cheerful expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. A colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size — but projecting forward from that waistline, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, its taut round surface distinct from the heavier soft folds that continue below it toward her hips. Enormous round hips, gigantic soft thighs pressed together. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, flawless pale-golden skin, sharply defined dark brows, a precise black winged liner with a strong flick, warm brown-bronze eyeshadow, long dramatic lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, strong contour under the cheekbones, deep red glossy lips with a crisp edge, a poised, dramatic expression, warm auburn red-brown hair styled in countless fine micro braids, real pores, real living eyes, 50 drop dangles piercings set with pearls in mixed metal-toned metal, wearing four to six pieces, layered of rose-gold earrings. Painted in 2 different traditional patterns repeated across 3 regions of her figure, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, the patterns reading as a continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 3 vertical bands by 2 hazy transition zones centred about 48% of the way across her figure from her left edge and about 76% of the way across her figure from her left edge. The regions alternate between 2 patterns in a repeating order. Region 1 is everything to her left of the first transition zone: it is painted in Chinese Cizhou sgraffito ceramic (a glossy jet-black glaze carved to cream-white peony scrolls), wide carved cream bands following the contours of the body, with leaf scrolls filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the strip between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it is painted in Yoruba adire eleko pattern (a deep indigo ground with bold cream resist-painted geometric motifs), wide cream bands following the contours of the body, with geometric bird motifs filling the space between bands. Region 3 is everything to her right of the last transition zone: it is painted in the same pattern as Region 1. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring patterns dissolve into each other, motifs from one thinning out as motifs from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one pattern, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. The bands of every pattern curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare. Pose: standing at a slight three-quarter angle, one hand resting on her own hip and the other beneath her belly's curve, composed radiant expression, her extreme platform high heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

#2: Japanese, in her late 40s, bold and confident expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy on top of an already immense frame. An immense mass of soft heavy fat already sits on her middle in heavy rounded folds — and rising from the top of that mass, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projects even further forward, its taut round surface distinct from the looser folds beneath it, no waist at all anywhere. A gigantic bust resting above the belly, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Region 1 is everything above the first transition zone: it is painted in Norwegian rosemaling folk painting (a deep forest-green ground with bold cream and gold acanthus scrollwork), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, with acanthus scrollwork filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it is painted in Ethiopian cross-and-lattice gold pattern (a deep wine-red ground with fine gold lattice linework), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, with lattice linework filling the space between bands. Region 3 is everything below the last transition zone: it is painted in the same pattern as Region 1. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. The bands of every pattern curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare. Pose: kneeling on both knees facing the camera directly, both hands resting lightly atop the dome of her belly, serene direct eye contact, her extreme platform wedges, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle on any of them. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 aspect ratio, 8K.
